bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to adversarial prefilling attacks that introduce sexist statements mid-generation, using an LLM judge (Gemini 2.0) to assess the safety and toxicity of the continuations.

Evaluating model responses to adversarial prefilling attacks that introduce racist or culturally stereotyping statements mid-generation, using an LLM judge to determine if the model successfully backtracks or continues the unsafe generation.

Testing model robustness against jailbreak prompts and prefilling attacks containing hateful content toward specific religions (e.g., Islam), using an LLM judge to assess if the model yields harmful information or successfully mitigates the attack.
